correctness.rationale: An exact iff witness predicate on 24 edges and 276 unordered pairs is checked by two independently programmed 65536-subset enumerations, one using BFS signature vectors and the other Floyd–Warshall plus bitmask hitting constraints. Both establish all joint polynomial coefficients, the strict 4 vs 5 threshold, and complete 512-state slide/jump adjacency and all-root BFS distances. Exhaustive automorphism backtracking yields 96 automorphisms and eight optimal-set orbits. The finite proof has no unproved extrapolation.
